transcript.text: Lincoln! I've been riding for a week handling depositions in Bloomington, trusting you to mind the office, and I come back to this! Let us work together to rectify this situation. Firstly, we must locate the missing Henderson deposition. It is crucial to our case, and its absence is of great concern. I will search through the office diligently to see if it has been misplaced or inadvertently set aside.

As for Judge Davis's letter, I apologize for the oversight of leaving it unopened for so long. I will address it promptly and ensure that any necessary actions are taken without further delay. It is imperative that we maintain clear communication with the court and handle all correspondence in a timely manner.

I appreciate your understanding, William, and I assure you that I am committed to restoring order to our office and ensuring that such oversights do not occur in the future. Let us work together to set things right and continue our legal work with diligence and precision.
